--- a/h11/tests/test_receivebuffer_peek.py
+++ b/h11/tests/test_receivebuffer_peek.py
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+import pytest
+
+from .._receivebuffer import ReceiveBuffer
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("data,count,expected", [
+    (b"", 0, b""),
+    (b"", 10, b""),
+    (b"abcdef", 0, b""),
+    (b"abcdef", 2, b"ab"),
+    (b"abcdef", 99, b"abcdef"),
+])
+def test_peek_at_most_values(data, count, expected):
+    buf = ReceiveBuffer()
+    buf += data
+    result = buf.peek_at_most(count)
+    assert type(result) is bytes
+    assert result == expected
+    assert bytes(buf) == data
+    assert len(buf) == len(data)
+
+
+def test_peek_negative_count_does_not_consume():
+    buf = ReceiveBuffer()
+    buf += b"abcdef"
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        buf.peek_at_most(-1)
+    assert bytes(buf) == b"abcdef"
+    assert buf.maybe_extract_at_most(2) == b"ab"
+    assert buf.peek_at_most(99) == b"cdef"
+
+
+def test_peek_preserves_incremental_extraction():
+    buf = ReceiveBuffer()
+    buf += b"one\r"
+    assert buf.maybe_extract_next_line() is None
+    assert buf.peek_at_most(99) == b"one\r"
+    buf += b"\nsecond\r\n"
+    assert buf.peek_at_most(3) == b"one"
+    assert buf.maybe_extract_next_line() == b"one\r\n"
+    assert buf.maybe_extract_next_line() == b"second\r\n"
+    buf += b"A: 1\r\nB: 2\r\n\r"
+    assert buf.maybe_extract_lines() is None
+    assert buf.peek_at_most(4) == b"A: 1"
+    buf += b"\nbody"
+    assert buf.maybe_extract_lines() == [b"A: 1", b"B: 2"]
+    snapshot = buf.peek_at_most(99)
+    assert snapshot == b"body"
+    assert buf.maybe_extract_at_most(2) == b"bo"
+    assert snapshot == b"body"
+    assert buf.peek_at_most(99) == b"dy"

spec.question: Add `ReceiveBuffer.peek_at_most(count)` so a protocol-sniffing caller can inspect buffered bytes without consuming them. For a nonnegative integer count, return an immutable `bytes` object containing the first at most count currently buffered bytes; zero and an empty buffer must return `b""`, and a count larger than the buffer must return all buffered bytes. A negative count must raise ValueError without changing the buffer. Peeking must not alter the results of subsequent line, header-block, or fixed-count extractions, including after delimiters arrive in multiple appends. Return a unified diff against the non-test repository files.
